# Starling Components Demo

> Live interactive showcase for Starling UI, the SolidJS component library published on npm as `@cdx-foundation/cdx-solidjs-components`. Built with SolidJS, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## About

This is a single-page demo app for the Starling UI component library. Every section shows live, interactive component examples alongside their source code, and an interactive theme builder lets you tweak the design tokens and preview the result instantly.

Navigation is client-side only: switch sections from the sidebar, or press Ctrl+K for the command palette. There are no per-section URLs.

## What's on this page

- **Intro**: Landing hero for the library.
- **Get Started**: Installation and usage guide for the npm package.
- **Theming**: Design-token overview, CSS variables, and theme customization docs.
- **Theme Creator**: Interactive theme builder with live preview — edit background, panel, surface, border, foreground, and muted colors, then copy the generated token overrides. Also serves as a kitchen-sink preview of most components (Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, Checkbox, Collapsible, ColorPicker, DatePicker, HoverCard, Kbd, Modal, Popover, Progress, RadioGroup, SegmentedControl, Separator, Skeleton, Slider, Switch, Table, Tooltip, and more).
- **Layout**: Card, ScrollArea, AspectRatio.
- **Forms**: Button, Input, Label, SegmentedControl, Select, Slider, Switch, Textarea.
- **Navigation**: Tabs, Breadcrumb. The app shell itself uses the Sidebar component and a Command palette.
- **Data**: Badge, Table, Calendar (single/range/multiple with time picker), DatePicker, Code, Select, Switch.
- **Feedback**: Alert, Progress, Skeleton, Toast.
- **Overlays**: Modal, Sheet, Popover, Tooltip, HoverCard.
- **Disclosure**: Accordion.
- **Utils**: Hooks (`useTheme`, `useDisclosure`) and directives (`autofocus`, `clipboard`, `hover`).

## Library

The `@cdx-foundation/cdx-solidjs-components` package (Solid.js, published as ESM + CJS) includes the components shown above plus: DropdownMenu, Menubar, NavigationMenu, ContextMenu, Pagination, Carousel, Floating, Resizable, ColorPicker, Sidebar, Command, and more. It ships with a design-token `theme.css` available under the `@cdx-foundation/cdx-solidjs-components/theme` export.

## Local development

The repository root is the library itself; the demo lives in `demo/`. The project uses the Vite+ toolchain (`vp`).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cdx-foundation/cdx-solidjs-components.git
cd cdx-solidjs-components
vp install
vp dev        # starts the demo at http://localhost:5173
```

Run `vp check` for lint/format/typecheck and `vp test` for the test suite. The demo is deployed to GitHub Pages from the `master` branch by the `Deploy Demo` workflow.
